codeReview.summary: The theme tokens package is well-implemented and fully covers the feature requirements. The package exists at internal/interfaces/tui/theme/ with a ColorPalette struct (20 named color tokens) and SpacingTokens struct (8 tiers). The dark-first palette follows DESIGN.md's 'operator console' tone with ANSI 256 and RGB colors. The package-level doc comment clearly states the no-raw-color-literals rule with explicit exemptions. All M2 widget implementations in internal/interfaces/tui/components/ reference theme.Colors.* tokens exclusively — no raw color literals found in any widget .go file. Tests are thorough (10 test cases) covering token validity, status-color pairwise distinctness, dark-first palette properties, spacing monotonicity, and palette↔struct consistency.

issues.description: The feature description says the theme path should be 'declared in docs/plans/tui-redesign/architecture.md', but that doc does not explicitly declare 'internal/interfaces/tui/theme/' as the theme package path. The component-spec.md references theme tokens in a 'forthcoming' note at line 842, and research-go-tui.md mentions a theme package at line 663. The mission AGENTS.md and .factory/library/architecture.md both list 'internal/interfaces/tui/theme/' as an expected path. This is not a blocking issue since the path is consistent with all planning docs, but the architecture.md could benefit from an explicit declaration of the theme package path.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The go-tui framework's color API (tui.ANSIColor, tui.RGBColor, tui.Color.IsDefault, tui.Color.IsLight, tui.Color.Equal) was used correctly but required the worker to read the go-tui module cache source at ~/go/pkg/mod/github.com/grindlemire/go-tui@v0.11.0/color.go. The key color API surface (ANSIColor, RGBColor, IsDefault, IsLight, Equal) could be documented in .factory/library/ so future workers don't need to explore the module cache.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows worker reading color.go from module cache: 'Read ~/go/pkg/mod/github.com/grindlemire/go-tui@v0.11.0/color.go' before creating tokens.go
